PBA Saturday Club Rides

Plano, TX · Road

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

PBA Saturday Club Rides is a road group ride in Plano, TX. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Gulledge Elementary School parking lot (novice groups); faster groups start at Spring Creek & Coit. About 20–60+ miles, many groups; Novice is ~20 miles at 11–13 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 11–13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the PBA Saturday Club Rides group ride

Plano Bicycle Association runs a ladder of Saturday rides, from Novice up to fast groups. Novice, Step-Up and B Squared leave from Gulledge Elementary and are no-drop. The club asks new riders to start one level below where they think they belong. Ride leaders hold the posted speed.
